services.title: Interior Painting

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior coatings. We scrape, prime, and paint fascias, soffits, doors, and timber — lasting results in any Bristol climate.

services.desc: Make a statement with a bold feature wall or carefully chosen accent colour. We help you choose the right shade and execute it flawlessly.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim

services.title: Commercial Painting

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Finishes

about_pullquote: We don't rush jobs. A good paint finish takes proper prep and the right technique.
about_para_1: Painter and Decorators Bristol has been transforming homes and commercial spaces across Bristol for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that a great finish starts with preparation, we've built a reputation for reliable, hardworking service and attention to detail. Every project — whether a quick bedroom refresh or a full exterior respray — gets the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we turn up on time, we don't overcharge, and the finish speaks for itself. We work across Henbury, Southmead, Westbury, and throughout greater Bristol. Fully insured, references available, and always happy to provide a free, honest quote before we start.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole house painted inside. The lads were tidy, friendly, and finished bang on schedule. Paint finish is brilliant — really smooth. Would definitely recommend and use them again.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Needed my kitchen repainted after water damage. Got a quote same day, started within a week, and they matched the rest of the house perfectly. Proper job. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house was looking tired. These guys scraped, primed, and painted everything. Weather-resistant finish, and it's held up beautifully through the winter. Very impressed.
reviews.author: David P.
